---
title: "Step 1 - Training and Validation Data"
output:
  html_document:
    df_print: paged
---

## **Global**

```{r, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

Data <- read_csv("project_traindata.csv")

CategoricalVars <- c("make", "segment", "transmission", "fuel_type", "province",
                     "service_history", "accident_history", "seller_type", "colour")

DropVars <- c("model_year", "warranty_months", "province", "colour")

CompareVars <- c("segment", "transmission", "make", "service_history", "fuel_type")

TrainShare <- 0.80
```

## **Preparing the Data**

#### 1.Categorical variables as factors

```{r}
Data <- Data %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(CategoricalVars), as.factor))

Data %>%
  select(all_of(CategoricalVars)) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), nlevels)) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Levels") %>%
  kable(caption = "Number of levels per categorical variable")
```

#### 2.Removed variables

```{r}
ModelData <- Data %>%
  select(-all_of(DropVars))

CategoricalVars <- setdiff(CategoricalVars, DropVars)

kable(data.frame(Removed = DropVars), caption = "Variables removed before the split")

dim(ModelData)
```

## **Random Split**

#### 3.Seed and training-set size

```{r}
set.seed(244)

n <- nrow(ModelData)
TrainSize <- floor(TrainShare * n)

kable(
  data.frame(Total = n, Training = TrainSize, Validation = n - TrainSize),
  caption = "Planned split sizes"
)
```

#### 4.Training and validation sets

```{r}
TrainRows <- sample(1:n, size = TrainSize, replace = FALSE)

TrainingData   <- ModelData[TrainRows, ]
ValidationData <- ModelData[-TrainRows, ]
```

#### 5.Dimensions and total

```{r}
kable(
  data.frame(
    Set = c("Training", "Validation", "Total"),
    Rows = c(nrow(TrainingData), nrow(ValidationData),
             nrow(TrainingData) + nrow(ValidationData)),
    Columns = c(ncol(TrainingData), ncol(ValidationData), NA)
  ),
  caption = "Dimensions of the two sets"
)

nrow(TrainingData) + nrow(ValidationData) == n
```

#### 6.Listing IDs per set

```{r}
TrainingIDs   <- TrainingData$listing_id
ValidationIDs <- ValidationData$listing_id

kable(
  data.frame(
    Training_IDs = length(TrainingIDs),
    Validation_IDs = length(ValidationIDs),
    IDs_in_both_sets = length(intersect(TrainingIDs, ValidationIDs))
  ),
  caption = "Listing IDs in each set"
)

TrainingData   <- TrainingData %>% select(-listing_id)
ValidationData <- ValidationData %>% select(-listing_id)
```

## **Comparing the Two Sets**

```{r, include=FALSE}
SplitData <- bind_rows(
  TrainingData %>% mutate(Set = "Training"),
  ValidationData %>% mutate(Set = "Validation")
)

split_prop_table <- function(var) {
  SplitData %>%
    count(Set, .data[[var]]) %>%
    group_by(Set) %>%
    mutate(Percent = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(-n) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Set, values_from = Percent, values_fill = 0) %>%
    mutate(Difference = Training - Validation) %>%
    rename(Category = 1) %>%
    kable(caption = paste("Percentage of each set by", var))
}
```

#### 7.Price summary

```{r}
SplitData %>%
  group_by(Set) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    Average_price = round(mean(price), 0),
    Median_price = round(median(price), 0),
    Spread_sd = round(sd(price), 0),
    Min_price = min(price),
    Max_price = max(price)
  ) %>%
  kable(caption = "Price in the training and validation sets")
```

#### 8.Price distribution

```{r}
ggplot(SplitData, aes(x = price, fill = Set)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, colour = "white") +
  facet_wrap(~ Set, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of price per set", x = "price", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

ggplot(SplitData, aes(x = Set, y = price)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.6, outlier.alpha = 0.4) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 18, size = 2.5, colour = "red") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(title = "price by set", x = "Set", y = "price") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(SplitData, aes(x = vehicle_age, y = price, colour = Set)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(title = "price vs vehicle_age per set", x = "vehicle_age", y = "price") +
  theme_minimal()
```

#### 9.Important categorical variables

```{r, results="asis"}
for (v in CompareVars) {
  print(split_prop_table(v))
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

#### 10.Validation categories present in training

```{r}
data.frame(
  Variable = CategoricalVars,
  Levels_only_in_validation = sapply(CategoricalVars, function(v) {
    NewLevels <- setdiff(unique(as.character(ValidationData[[v]])),
                         unique(as.character(TrainingData[[v]])))
    if (length(NewLevels) == 0) "All present in training" else paste(NewLevels, collapse = ", ")
  }),
  row.names = NULL
) %>%
  kable(caption = "Categories in validation that never appear in training")
```

#### 11.Missing values after the split

```{r}
data.frame(
  Variable = names(TrainingData),
  Training = colSums(is.na(TrainingData)),
  Validation = colSums(is.na(ValidationData)),
  row.names = NULL
) %>%
  kable(caption = "Missing values per variable in each set")

SplitData %>%
  count(Set, service_history) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Set, values_from = n) %>%
  kable(caption = "service_history levels per set")
```
